description.en:
Locks a player into a role in the team lineup, or removes the lock. Story matches use it so the player cannot move key characters: for example keeping one character in goal or sending an injured one to the bench.
Locks are stored in a list of 32 entries (player, lock type, scope). The lineup screen checks the lineup against them: a locked player standing outside their allowed positions is reported, with the lock type and the player. The lineup positions are 0 = goalkeeper, 1 to 10 = field players, 11 to 15 = bench:
- LOCK_TYPE_FIELDER (0): must be at a position from 1 to 10;
- LOCK_TYPE_KEEPER (1): must be at position 0;
- LOCK_TYPE_BENCH (2): must be at a position from 11 to 15.
The scope says when the lock applies, depending on which team the player controls (the same match-setup value CMND_BTL_IS_CPU uses): 0 = only when it is team 0, 1 = only when it is team 1, 2 or more (the default) = always.

With false, the first lock on that player whose scope covers the given scope is removed (the lock type is not compared). To change a player's lock, the scripts remove the old one and add the new one. CMND_BTL_DEL_POS_LOCK also removes a lock, and CMND_BTL_RESET_POS_LOCK clears them all.
true to add or update the lock, false to remove it.
Parameter ID of the player, e.g. "para_cp0003".
LOCK_TYPE_FIELDER (0), LOCK_TYPE_KEEPER (1) or LOCK_TYPE_BENCH (2), constants from ie4_ev_main.nut.
0 = only when the player controls team 0, 1 = only when the player controls team 1, 2 or more = always.
Always null (also when fewer than 3 arguments are given).

examples.case: Locking the lineup in the pre-match setup (real usage, from btl0003.nut)
Moving a player from the bench into the field lock before a scene (real usage, from btl0008.nut)
